parameters.name: AddressIpVersion
parameters.description:
The protocol version. Valid value:

- **Ipv4**: IPv4.

parameters.name: LoadBalancerBusinessStatus
parameters.description:
The business status of the GWLB instance. Valid values:

- **Normal**: The instance is running as expected.

- **FinancialLocked**: The instance is locked due to an overdue payment.

parameters.name: LoadBalancerIds
parameters.description: The list of GWLB instance IDs. You can query up to 20 instance IDs at a time.

parameters.name: LoadBalancerNames
parameters.description: The list of GWLB instance names. You can query up to 20 instance names at a time.

parameters.name: LoadBalancerStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the GWLB instance. Valid values:

- **Active**: The instance is running.

- **Inactive**: The instance is stopped. In this state, the listener of the instance does not forward traffic.

- **Provisioning**: The instance is being created.

- **Configuring**: The instance is being modified.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 1000. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The token that is used for the next query. Valid values:

- If **NextToken** is empty, it indicates that no next query is to be sent.

- If **NextToken** has a value, the value is the token that is used for the next query.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: Skip
parameters.description: The number of entries to skip.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The list of tags. You can specify up to 20 tags in each call.

parameters.name: TrafficMode
parameters.description:
The traffic mode. Valid values:

- **LoadBalance**: The instance is in load balancing mode.

- **ByPass**: The instance is in bypass mode.

parameters.name: VpcIds
parameters.description: The list of virtual private cloud (VPC) IDs. You can query up to 20 VPC IDs at a time.

parameters.name: ZoneIds
parameters.description: The list of zone IDs. You can query up to 20 zone IDs at a time.
